item.title: SaaS for Insurance Broker Commission Tracker
item.description:
5000-10000 CAD | Insurance Broker SaaS Web App – Book of Business & Commission Tracking
I’m looking for an experienced SaaS developer or development team to build a simple, modern web application for individual insurance brokers/producers.
The main purpose is to help brokers manage their personal book of business, expected commissions, actual commission payments, unpaid/partial commissions, and renewals—as a better alternative to Excel spreadsheets.
Core Features
* Broker signup/login with a 3-day free trial * Monthly and annual membership plans * Personal book of business * Client and policy management * Premium and commission tracking * Automatic expected commission calculation * Dashboard showing expected, paid, unpaid and partial commissions * Upload commission statements in Excel/CSV and supported PDF formats * Automatic matching of commission statements against the broker’s book * Identify paid, unpaid, partial and mismatched commissions * Manual review and correction of matches * Statement history and reconciliation records * Renewal tracking with upcoming renewal views * Basic reports and Excel/CSV export * Responsive design for mobile, tablet and desktop * Secure user data isolation * Admin panel for users, memberships, trial settings and website/pricing content
Future-Ready Architecture
The system should be designed so future features can be added without rebuilding the application, including:
* Google/Gmail login * Email and push notifications * Client policy-change request forms * Optional client communication campaigns * Additional insurance carrier statement formats
This is not intended to be a full brokerage AMS/CRM. The goal is a focused, easy-to-use productivity and commission reconciliation tool for individual brokers.
I’m open to your recommended technology stack, but the solution should use a modern, scalable architecture and provide full source-code ownership and documentation.
Please include in your proposal:
* Your fixed project price * Estimated timeline * Recommended technology stack * Relevant SaaS/financial/reconciliation experience * Examples of similar projects * Development milestones * Hosting and third-party costs * Post-launch support/maintenance options
